method: Originally read the official update index and all five listed articles on 2 November. Rechecked the official Steam announcement feed on 7 November: 2.0.6 remains the latest versioned update; later posts concern outfits and a sale. Re-read the available patch announcement contents.
global: 2.0.6 corrects five fixed-level Sigils incorrectly obtained at trait level 11 to level 15. Their level-11 versions are not equipment targets.
2.0.5 fixes equipping Master Traits beyond their limit. These plans retain legal rank budgets and specialization requirements.
2.0.2 changes buff/debuff damage calculations and many skill strengths. Pre-expansion ATK-buff values, damage ratios and rankings are not carried over as current measurements.
Potion Hoarder 15 grants one extra revival potion. Potion healing is capped, so more maximum HP does not proportionally increase every potion's healing.

captain.note: Dodging during Power Raise preserves its charge. Phalanx reaches all allies; Substitute grants DMG Cut and can intercept unguardable attacks.

katalina.note: Dodging during Ares Pactstrike no longer dismisses Ares. Guardian's Warpath uses the reduced ER buff strength; old values are not assumed.

rackam.note: Normal attacks and Bull's Eye Blast V were strengthened. Walking fire retains auto aim; old damage ratios and Wild Gunsmoke buff values need ER data.

io.note: Mage's Warpath now works in Link Time. Stargaze, Lightning and Flowery Seven were adjusted; pre-ER ratios and the old Link Time bug are not used.

eugen.note: The AI sniper-vision bug and several aiming/dodge delays were fixed. Venom Grenade's DEF-down strength was reduced with the new damage calculation.

rosetta.note: Entering critical condition no longer removes or resets planted roses. Rose Tycoon restores rose gauges. Separate Master Trait damage/reset conditions still need to be respected.

charlotta.note: Noble Stance power finishers were strengthened. Konigsschild reaches all allies, and Valiant Stance uses reduced stackable ATK buffs.

ghandagoza.note: True Avidya's ATK buff and Lion Stance's Jammed strength changed with ER's damage calculation. Old buff values are not current build evidence.

ferry.note: Beppo summoned by Umlauf counts for pet-dependent effects. Pendel, Strafe and pet attacks now generate SBA per hit; old SBA-generation comparisons are not assumed.

narmaya.note: Setsuna must finish its final slash before another attack starts. The Transient dodge/charge cooldown bug was fixed. Warpath's SBA-generation penalty is now 30%, not 50%.

lancelot.note: Avalanche and combo transitions were revised. Flight over Fight triggers only through the dodge button and applies DMG-down; it is not free damage or a substitute for every mastery-specific dodge trigger.

vane.note: Heavy Swing's gauge-on-block bug was fixed. AI Vane may choose to dodge a lethal block; a manual blocking rotation is not guaranteed AI behavior.

percival.note: Schlacht ++ was strengthened and several skill-buff values changed. This guide does not rely on historical skill-cancel exploits or pre-ER damage comparisons.

siegfried.note: Mirage grants DMG Cut. Warpath's DEF penalty is now 30%, not 50%; Draconic Release uses reduced stackable ATK buffs and received premature-expiry fixes.

cagliostro.note: The repeated Founder's Truth cooldown trigger after a Combo C dodge cancel was fixed. Legitimate recovery cancels do not imply an infinite cooldown-reset loop.

yodarha.note: Combo finishers were strengthened and shortened combos received hit-count fixes. The unintended Empty Mist cooldown reset was fixed.

zeta.note: Arvess Fermare's extra damage benefits only the Zeta who applied it. Realm's Majesty counter invulnerability was extended; old party-wide Fermare assumptions are invalid.

vaseraga.note: Charged unique attacks can follow all damage/debuff skills. Netherwrath can intercept unguardable attacks; unintended skill resets are not part of the plan.

beatrix.note: Dodging after a combo finisher during Devour Causality no longer breaks the combo. Delta Clock supports one-press and double-press mode changes.

eustace.note: No Eustace-specific balance change is listed in 2.0.3 through 2.0.6. Retain the ER skill/grade rules and the rank-gated refill loop; patch silence is not an independent timing test.

id.note: Godmight power-strike combos survive dodges. Fourfold Vengeance's base power was reduced for ER's Master Traits; pre-ER ratios are not used as proof of its current output.

sandalphon.note: AI Talviyo's missed-link bug was fixed in 2.0.3. ER also reduced Chromatic Wings attack/stun and Revontulet stun, so old Lightstep/Revontulet rankings are not current evidence.

seofon.note: Avatar finishers no longer reset Avatar gauge, and dismissing the avatar below maximum Swordshine preserves its level. Old forced-reset rotations are not required.

tweyen.note: Combo C, fully charged Multilock Hail and Volley's damage buff were strengthened. Two-Crown's Strife extends enemy debuffs, not enemy buffs.

fraux.note: No Fraux-specific balance change is listed in 2.0.3 through 2.0.6. Retain the ER rank-gated gauge/Strength Gains rules; this does not independently validate every animation or damage ratio.

fediel.note: Enhanced Combo Finishers caps at five levels. Unstacked magic orbs were weakened and their scaling adjusted; the old zero-stack finisher-spam advice is obsolete. Maximum-stack damage remains roughly comparable, not a verified numerical ratio.

gallanza.note: SBA requires a full gauge. Entering Deathmatch Finale or reaching maximum Wild Showman no longer permits the old underfilled-gauge SBA activation bug.

maglielle.note: No Maglielle-specific balance change is listed in 2.0.3 through 2.0.6. Retain the ER skill and rank gates; this official-note check does not independently validate specialist animation timings.
